title: Adjective and qualifier bank
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 1: Local area, holiday and travel: town, region and country; holidays (2.3, 2.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 2 (Adjective and qualifier bank (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 2: Bridge: describing people: agreement, the dual and qualifiers. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

head: Qualifier
Example
rows: هِيَ خَجُولَةٌ قَلِيلًا: a little shy
أَخِي طَوِيلٌ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا: fairly tall

parts.text: صَدِيقِي عُمَرُ طَوِيلٌ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا وَلَهُ شَعْرٌ أَسْوَدُ قَصِيرٌ.
هُوَ أَطْوَلُ مِنِّي لٰكِنَّهُ أَصْغَرُ مِنِّي.

questions.q: Describe a cheerful, fairly tall female cousin.
questions.a: بِنْتُ عَمِّي مَرِحَةٌ وَطَوِيلَةٌ إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا.

questions.q: Core: Write 70 to 90 words (portal response box): صِفْ شَخْصًا تُعْجَبُ بِهِ (describe someone you admire), with appearance, character, a qualifier, a comparison and a reason.
questions.a: Marked for agreement (gender, dual), qualifiers, comparison with أَفْعَل مِنْ, opinion with reason.

questions.q: Extend (Group B): prepare a 30-second spoken description for the picture-based task style: يَبْدُو ... (he seems ...).
Stretch (Group A): give the i'rab of طَوِيلٌ in صَدِيقِي طَوِيلٌ.
questions.a: خَبَرٌ مَرْفُوعٌ وَعَلَامَةُ رَفْعِهِ الضَّمَّةُ (predicate, nominative, marked by dammah)
A) لَهَا أُخْتَانِ لَطِيفَتَانِ. Dual noun, dual adjective: أُخْتَانِ لَطِيفَتَانِ.

questions.q: What does إِلَى حَدٍّ مَا mean? A) fairly B) very C) never
Big question: what makes a description precise?
questions.a: Agreeing adjectives (including dual), qualifiers and comparisons.
